While robustness is a perfectly valid research objective, we recommend being careful when
using both robustness with interpretability to motivate the same method, as this often leads to
functionally-groundedness issues. We would therefore advocate for more counterfactual research
whichfocusesonly on interpretabilityand functionally-groundedness .
